info.name: DutyCheck
info.summary: Duty-roster planning, validation, and auditable lifecycle for security services
info.description: DutyCheck provides secure duty roster planning for shift-driven teams. It covers period-based scheduling, conflict validation, controlled publish and close workflows, self-service absence requests, and immutable evidence snapshots for audit trails. The backend is the source of truth for conflict and lifecycle rules. The interface is role-aware, WCAG 2.1 AA aligned, and responsive down to 320 pixels.
info.author: Alexander Mäule
